policy: Review every closed candidate set. Select only when ASV wording or an explicit mapped textual note distinguishes a reading; otherwise mark underdetermined and retain the base fallback. The base candidate is the SBLGNT reading.

decisions.evidence: ASV 'when the Lamb opened' directly reflects temporal ὅτε rather than causal/content ὅτι.
ASV main text has only 'Come'; its note assigns 'and see' to some authorities, supporting the base without the addition.
ASV 'And I saw, and behold' excludes the RP omission but cannot distinguish the base punctuation from r01; the base fallback is retained.
ASV 'the second seal' explicitly reflects the article in the base reading; RP lacks it.
ASV retains the corresponding coordination in 'and that they should slay one another', supporting base καί.
ASV 'that they should slay' can render either future indicative σφάξουσιν or aorist subjunctive σφάξωσιν under ἵνα.
ASV 'and I saw' reflects indicative εἶδον, not imperative ἴδε.
ASV 'as it were a voice' explicitly reflects comparative ὡς.
ASV mass noun 'barley' does not distinguish plural genitive κριθῶν from singular κριθῆς.
ASV 'I heard the voice of the fourth living creature' explicitly reflects φωνήν.
ASV main text has only 'Come'; its note assigns 'and see' to some authorities.
ASV 'And I saw, and behold' excludes the omission but cannot distinguish punctuation-only base and r01; the base fallback is retained.
ASV 'with him' can render either μετ᾽ αὐτοῦ or dative αὐτῷ.
ASV plural 'authority was given unto them' reflects base αὐτοῖς rather than singular αὐτῷ.
ASV has simply 'the testimony which they held' and no 'of the Lamb', supporting the base without the addition.
ASV 'that they should rest' does not securely distinguish future ἀναπαύσονται from subjunctive ἀναπαύσωνται under ἵνα.
ASV 'yet for a little time' directly reflects μικρόν; RP omits it.
ASV main text 'should have fulfilled their course' reflects active πληρώσωσιν; its note assigns passive 'be fulfilled in number' to some authorities.
ASV has only one 'and' between 'their fellow-servants' and 'their brethren', matching the separate base-text καί already following this unit; the RP addition would introduce a second conjunction.
The readings are spelling variants of the same infinitive; ASV 'should be killed' cannot distinguish them.
ASV 'the sun became black' does not determine Greek order.
ASV finite comparison 'as a fig tree casteth' reflects base βάλλει rather than participle βαλοῦσα.
ASV plural 'the great day of their wrath' reflects base αὐτῶν rather than singular αὐτοῦ.
